map.定期还款（约定还款日）: Fixed repayment on an agreed date
map.未约定还款期限（可随时主张）: No repayment term, so demand may be made at any time
map.出借人主张还款日期（或宽限期届满日）: Date the lender demanded repayment, or the date the grace period ended
map.最后一次催款日期（发送催款函/微信/短信）: Date of the last demand, whether by letter, chat message or text
map.最后一次部分还款日期: Date of the last partial repayment
map.债务人承诺还款日期: Date the debtor promised to repay
map.• 普通诉讼时效：3年（自权利人知道或应当知道权利受损及义务人之日起）: • General limitation: 3 years from the date the right holder knew or should have known of the damage and of the obligor
map.• 最长保护期：20年（自权利受损之日起，特殊情况可延长）: • Maximum protection period: 20 years from the date of the damage, extendable in special cases
map.• 分期履行债务：诉讼时效自最后一期履行期限届满之日起计算: • Debts payable by instalments: the period runs from the date the last instalment falls due
map.时效中断的法定事由（重新计算3年）：: Statutory grounds of interruption, after which the 3 years start again:
map.• 权利人向义务人提出履行请求（催款、发函等，需保留证据）: • The right holder demands performance from the obligor, such as by a demand or letter, with evidence kept
map.• 义务人同意履行义务（部分还款、承诺还款、提供担保等）: • The obligor agrees to perform, by partial repayment, a promise to pay, or providing security
map.• 权利人提起诉讼或申请仲裁: • The right holder files suit or applies for arbitration
map.• 与提起诉讼或申请仲裁具有同等效力的其他情形: • Other circumstances with equivalent effect to filing suit or applying for arbitration
map.超过诉讼时效起诉的，被告提出时效抗辩的，法院将驳回原告诉讼请求: Where suit is filed after the period has expired and the defendant raises a limitation defence, the court will dismiss the plaintiff's claim
map.约定还款日的借款，从届满日起算 3 年时效。: For a loan with an agreed repayment date, the 3 years run from that date.
map.分期借款从最后一期履行期限届满之日起算。: For an instalment loan, they run from the date the last instalment falls due.
map.未约定还款期的，从出借人首次催款之日起算 3 年。: With no repayment term, they run for 3 years from the lender's first demand.
map.借款 2022-01-01、约定 2023-01-01 还，时效自次日起算 3: A loan taken on 2022-01-01 and repayable on 2023-01-01 starts its 3 years the next day, expiring on 2026-01-01.
map.若 2024 年借款人部分还款，视为同意履行，时效自该日重新计算 3 年，新届满: A partial repayment in 2024 counts as agreement to perform, so the 3 years restart from that date to about 2027.
map.借条没写还款日怎么办？: What if the IOU has no repayment date?
map.可随时要求还款并给合理期限，时效从你首次主张权利之日起算 3 年；建议留存催款证: Repayment may be demanded at any time on reasonable notice, and the 3 years run from the first assertion of the right; keep evidence of the demand to fix the start date.
